record.question: The medical certification of the cause of death is normally the responsibility of the:
record.explanation: Answer D: Attending physician. The physician who attended the patient is normally responsible for certifying the medical cause of death. Source/context note: Local law determines who may certify a death; this describes the usual clinical responsibility. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241549949. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
